meta.name: Review Zendesk escalations with OpenAI, Qdrant, Slack and human approval

name: Customer Escalation Intelligence - Creator Hub clean

parameters.content:
## Start here

Configure PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenAI, Zendesk, Qdrant and Slack credentials.

Run database.sql, create the Qdrant collection/indexes, import error-handler.json as the workflow error handler, then test with a non-production Zendesk ticket.

# Customer Escalation Intelligence

Main path: Zendesk event -> durable claim -> redacted ticket context -> AI analysis -> Qdrant evidence -> Slack approval -> Zendesk private note.

Supporting path: reviewed outcomes can be indexed back into Qdrant after human confirmation.

## 01. Authenticate and validate

Accept one trusted webhook event. Reject unsafe payloads before loading tenant configuration.

parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, config FROM swl_escalation.deployments WHERE deployment_id='default';

parameters.content:
## 02. Claim and acknowledge

Claim each event once in PostgreSQL, acknowledge duplicates, then fetch the current Zendesk ticket.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO swl_escalation.cases AS c(tenant_id,event_id,ticket_id,execution_id)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4)
ON CONFLICT (tenant_id,event_id) DO UPDATE SET
  execution_id=CASE WHEN c.status='retry_ready' AND c.ticket_id=EXCLUDED.ticket_id THEN EXCLUDED.execution_id ELSE c.execution_id END,
  status=CASE WHEN c.status='retry_ready' AND c.ticket_id=EXCLUDED.ticket_id THEN 'processing' ELSE c.status END,
  updated_at=CASE WHEN c.status='retry_ready' AND c.ticket_id=EXCLUDED.ticket_id THEN now() ELSE c.updated_at END
RETURNING jsonb_build_object('caseId',id,'tenantId',tenant_id,'eventId',event_id,'ticketId',ticket_id,
  'executionId',execution_id,'accepted',execution_id=$4 AND status='processing' AND ticket_id=$3,
  'status',status,'config',$5::jsonb,'agents','{}'::jsonb) AS ctx;

parameters.jsCode: const ctx=$('Claim event').first().json.ctx; if(String($json.ticket?.id)!==ctx.ticketId) throw new Error('Unexpected ticket ID'); return [{json:{...ctx,rawTicket:$json.ticket}}];

parameters.content:
## 03. Retrieve recent conversation

Use Redis only as a short-lived cache. Cache misses fetch the latest public Zendesk comments.

parameters.jsCode: const {rawTicket,cached,cacheHit,...ctx}=$json; return [{json:{...ctx,ticket:cached}}];

parameters.content:
## 04. Cache and enrich

Store the redacted ticket snapshot briefly, then load verified account facts from PostgreSQL.

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:$('Redact conversation').first().json}];

parameters.content:
## 05. AI specialist - triage

Classify urgency and churn signals. Store validated AI output and usage in PostgreSQL.

## 06. Search approved vector memory

Embed the ticket summary and retrieve only approved, tenant-scoped Qdrant knowledge.

parameters.jsCode: const ctx = $json.ctx ?? $json; return [{json:{ctx,request:{model:'text-embedding-3-small',dimensions:1536,input:ctx.ticket.subject+'\n'+ctx.agents.triage.summary}}}];

parameters.content:
## 07. AI specialist - research

Check retrieved documents against the ticket. Cite only existing document IDs.

## 08. AI specialist - decision

Recommend escalation, monitoring or manual review using evidence and account context.

## 09. AI specialist - action planner

Draft the private Zendesk note and follow-up steps. This node does not execute actions.

## 10. AI specialist - independent QA

Review the proposed action for unsupported claims, privacy issues and policy gaps.

## 11. Apply policy and route

Deterministic checks decide whether the case can go to Slack approval or manual review.

parameters.query:
UPDATE swl_escalation.cases SET context=$1::jsonb,
status=CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN 'awaiting_approval' ELSE 'manual_review' END,
approval_expires_at=CASE WHEN $4::boolean THEN now()+make_interval(mins => $5::int) ELSE NULL END,
reason=$6,updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$2::uuid AND execution_id=$3 AND status='processing'
RETURNING context AS ctx;

parameters.content:
## 12. Wait for human approval

Send the exact proposed note to Slack. Only explicit approval allows the workflow to continue.

parameters.query:
UPDATE swl_escalation.cases SET
status=CASE WHEN $3::boolean AND approval_expires_at>now() THEN 'approved'
 WHEN NOT $3::boolean AND approval_expires_at>now() THEN 'rejected' ELSE 'manual_review' END,
reason=CASE WHEN approval_expires_at<=now() THEN 'Approval expired.' WHEN NOT $3::boolean THEN 'Declined or no explicit approval.' ELSE NULL END,
updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND execution_id=$2 AND status='awaiting_approval'
RETURNING context || jsonb_build_object('approved',status='approved','status',status) AS ctx;

parameters.content:
## 13. Recheck before execution

Fetch the ticket again after approval. Stop if the ticket changed before writing.

parameters.text: ={{ 'Manual review required: ticket '+$json.ctx.ticketId+' changed after the proposal. No write was made.' }}

parameters.content:
## 14. Execute and verify

Add the approved private note to Zendesk, then verify the returned audit marker.

## 15. Receive reviewed outcomes

Accept human-reviewed resolution feedback through a separate authenticated webhook.

parameters.query: SELECT tenant_id, config FROM swl_escalation.deployments WHERE deployment_id='default';

parameters.content:
## 16. Check case ownership

Confirm the case belongs to this tenant and the source ticket is resolved before learning from it.

parameters.query:
SELECT $1::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('found',c.id IS NOT NULL,
'ticketId',c.ticket_id,'caseStatus',c.status,'original',c.context) AS ctx
FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN swl_escalation.cases c
ON c.id=$2::uuid AND c.tenant_id=$3 AND c.status IN ('action_done','resolved');

parameters.responseBody: ={{ ({error:"Case not found in this tenant or its action is not complete."}) }}

parameters.jsCode: const ctx=$('Find completed case').first().json.ctx; if(String($json.ticket?.id)!==ctx.ticketId)throw new Error('Unexpected ticket ID');return [{json:{...ctx,resolved:['solved','closed'].includes($json.ticket.status)}}];

parameters.content:
## 17. Claim feedback once

Claim each feedback event once, acknowledge duplicates, then prepare the memory text.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO swl_escalation.feedback AS f(tenant_id,event_id,case_id,execution_id,outcome,summary)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3::uuid,$4,$5,$6)
ON CONFLICT (case_id) DO UPDATE SET
execution_id=CASE WHEN f.status='retry_ready' AND f.event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id THEN EXCLUDED.execution_id ELSE f.execution_id END,
status=CASE WHEN f.status='retry_ready' AND f.event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id THEN 'processing' ELSE f.status END,
updated_at=CASE WHEN f.status='retry_ready' AND f.event_id=EXCLUDED.event_id THEN now() ELSE f.updated_at END
RETURNING $7::jsonb || jsonb_build_object('feedbackId',id,
'accepted',execution_id=$4 AND status='processing' AND event_id=$2,'summary',summary,'outcome',outcome) AS ctx;

parameters.jsCode: const ctx = $json.ctx ?? $json; const text='Problem: '+ctx.original.agents.triage.summary+'\nOutcome: '+ctx.outcome+'\nResolution: '+ctx.summary; return [{json:{ctx,text,request:{model:'text-embedding-3-small',dimensions:1536,input:text}}}];

parameters.content:
## 18. Close the learning loop

Index reviewed outcomes into Qdrant as approved historical examples, not policies.

parameters.jsCode: if($json.status!=='ok'||$json.result?.status!=='completed')throw new Error('Qdrant did not confirm completed indexing');const p=$('Build reviewed memory point').first().json;return [{json:{...p.ctx,embeddingTokens:p.tokens,estimatedUsd:p.estimatedUsd}}];

parameters.content:
## 19. Watch overdue work

Expire stalled approvals and flag stuck work for operator review.

parameters.query:
WITH stalled AS (
UPDATE swl_escalation.cases SET
status=CASE WHEN status='action_inflight' THEN 'action_uncertain' WHEN status='awaiting_approval' THEN 'manual_review' ELSE 'failed' END,
reason=CASE WHEN status='awaiting_approval' THEN 'Approval expired.' WHEN status='action_inflight' THEN 'Action outcome needs reconciliation.' ELSE 'Execution stalled; inspect before replay.' END,
updated_at=now(),last_alerted_at=now()
WHERE (status='awaiting_approval' AND approval_expires_at<now())
OR (status IN ('processing','approved','action_inflight') AND updated_at<now()-interval '30 minutes')
RETURNING id,status,execution_id,reason
), feedback_stalled AS (
UPDATE swl_escalation.feedback SET status='failed',updated_at=now()
WHERE status='processing' AND updated_at<now()-interval '30 minutes' RETURNING id,execution_id
), dlq AS (
INSERT INTO swl_escalation.dead_letters(execution_id,case_id,failed_node,reason)
SELECT execution_id,id,'Watchdog',reason FROM stalled
ON CONFLICT(execution_id) DO NOTHING
), feedback_dlq AS (
INSERT INTO swl_escalation.dead_letters(execution_id,feedback_id,failed_node,reason)
SELECT execution_id,id,'Watchdog','Feedback indexing stalled.' FROM feedback_stalled
ON CONFLICT(execution_id) DO NOTHING
) SELECT jsonb_build_object('cases',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(stalled)) FROM stalled),'[]'::jsonb),
'feedback',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(feedback_stalled)) FROM feedback_stalled),'[]'::jsonb),
'config',(SELECT config FROM swl_escalation.deployments WHERE deployment_id='default')) AS report;

parameters.content:
## Data model and operator notes

PostgreSQL owns state and audit data. Redis is only a cache. Qdrant stores approved policy and reviewed outcomes.

Use error-handler.json as the workflow-level error handler for production failures.
